data.display_address: Diamondz by Danube, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai
data.long_description:
Introducing Diamondz, a prestigious project by Danube Properties, located in the vibrant Jumeirah Lake Towers. This striking 62-storey building draws inspiration from the diamond, symbolizing luxury and sophistication.

Diamondz offers an array of thoughtfully designed studios and spacious apartments, featuring multifunctional layouts and exquisite finishes. The contemporary interiors utilize a stunning color scheme with golden accents, creating a rich and inviting ambiance.

Residents will enjoy a wealth of world-class amenities, including a fully equipped gym, an infinity pool with a breathtaking waterfall, relaxation areas, a children's pool, trampoline, playgrounds, a kindergarten, barbecue zones, a spa, a Jacuzzi, a yoga studio, table tennis, a basketball court, jogging track, and party rooms.

The Jumeirah Lake Towers area boasts a well-established infrastructure, placing residents close to schools, medical centers, cafes, restaurants, and shopping centers. Marina Mall is just a 3-minute drive away, while iconic destinations like Palm Jumeirah, Mall of the Emirates, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai Cruise Terminal are within 8-10 minutes. Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are only 18 minutes away, with Dubai International Airport accessible in approximately 25 minutes.

For more information or to arrange a viewing, please contact:
